standard_question: How long is the smart home hub warranty?
similar_questions: How many years is the warranty
answers: The unit has a 24-month warranty; battery accessories have 12 months. Damage from disassembly or water is not covered.

standard_question: Does voice control work without internet?
similar_questions: Can I use voice control with no network
answers: If voice uses cloud recognition, only the app and the local touchscreen work without internet. With a local voice pack configured, basic commands keep working.

standard_question: How many hubs can one account bind?
similar_questions: What is the maximum number of hubs
answers: Up to 3 on the Personal edition. The Enterprise edition is licensed per contract, 50 by default.

standard_question: What is the accommodation reimbursement cap in tier-1 cities?
similar_questions: Hotel reimbursement limit in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen
answers: In tier-1 cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen) the cap is 600 CNY per night (tax included). You pay any amount over the cap.

standard_question: How are meals on business trips reimbursed?
answers: Meals on business trips are not reimbursed separately. You receive a daily travel allowance: 150 CNY/day in tier-1 cities, 120 CNY/day in other cities.

standard_question: When does the Q1 knowledge base POC go live?
similar_questions: When is the support knowledge base accepted
answers: The target is an intranet demo by 2024-03-01. Zhang Ming owns the technical delivery.

standard_question: Who owns the support knowledge base POC?
similar_questions: Who leads the knowledge base project
answers: The technical lead is Zhang Ming (R&D), the product contact is Li Wei, and the QA lead is Zhao Lei.

standard_question: Which protocols does Hub Pro support?
similar_questions: Which smart device protocols can it connect to
answers: It supports Matter, Zigbee 3.0, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Mesh. Firmware 3.5 is planned to pass Matter 1.2 certification.

standard_question: How many annual leave days come with 10 years of service?
similar_questions: Annual leave days by years of service
answers: 1–10 years of service gives 10 days of annual leave, over 10 years gives 15 days, counted from the hire date.

standard_question: When is Matter certification planned to finish?
answers: Firmware 3.5 is planned for a staged rollout by the end of March 2024, with Matter 1.2 certification completed.
